classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 3.11% of the pixels differ and the box is the same size. The slices, widths and the stretch, repeat, round and space layouts land on Chromium's rectangles; what is left is the picture's resampling in the filled middle (a 4px slice stretched over the box) and the seams where tiles meet. Without the border images the same fixture measures 38%, so it fails.
